The '''Nadon's grove''' was a grove of [[bafforr tree]]s that grew on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TSE" /> It was located in the [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] south of the [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] [[City/Legends|city]].<ref name="SoT" />
